tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// nyag brag yul gyi gzhi bdag 'bung chung stag ril 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod 'dod 'byung sprin gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang dag mtshan gyi rol mo su zhig gi /rna bar sim pas ngan 'gro 'khor ba yi// 'jigs pa las bsgral 'di nas byang chub bar// bde la sbyor ba dkon mchog gsum gyis skyongs// rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag yul gru 'dir// bstan pa bstan 'dzin ngur smrig 'chang gi sde// bsrung spel rnam dkar phrin las rgyas byed pa// 'bung chung stag ril bsang mchod gyer bsgom 'dri// de'ang 'di'i bsang mchod bya bar 'dod pas/ snod gcig tu zan leb zlum po'i steng du dkar gtor zlum por sked par mtheb kyu bzhis ri dwags rna ba ltar brgyan pa la mar rgyan ci mdzes btags/ g.yas g.yon mdun gsum du'ang de 'dra ba chung tsam re dang zan ril mang tsam dang bcas pa'i mthar/ g.yag lug ra gsum ri dwags sogs gzugs 'gros sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ gzhan yang phye mar ja chang phud gtsang gi rigs gang 'byor dang shing rtsi sman spos sna tshogs mer btul ba'i dud pa btang ba dang mda' dar sogs bsang rdzas ci 'byor bshams pa chab kyis bran la/ bsang mchod gzhan dang ma 'brel na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs tshar gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ bsang rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bshams pa'i mchod rdzas mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*// 'bru gsum yi ge las skyes gtor ma dang*// mchod rdzas bsang rdzas nam mkha'i khams gang ba// dge bsnyen 'khor bcas spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /sarba pū dza spha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ kye 'dod 'byung sa 'dzin phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus// rdo rje'i brag ri dpangs mtho'i 'gram pa nas// nyin mtshan sgron ma'i rna cha zung g.yo zhing*// rgyu skar phreng bas mgrin pa brgyan snyam byed// de yi nang rol las kyi 'phrul bskrun pa'i// rin chen khang bzang rtsig pa pha gu dang*// mda' yab thog phub tog dang sgo rgyan sogs// bkod legs blta na sdug pa'i khyams kun du// lha mi gdengs can kun gyi dpal 'byor dang*// longs spyod gya nom lo legs 'bru yi rigs// zad mi shes pa spungs pa'i gter gyi mdzod// rnam rgyal khang bzang la 'gran bsti gnas nas// bstan la gus shing 'jig rten skyong ba la// rdzu 'phrul mthu chen 'bung chung stag ril dang*// mtshar sdug dar bab lang tsho'i zhags pa yi// gzhan yid 'ching ba'i btsun mo lcam zhang blon// mched 'khor grangs med dpung gi tshogs dang bcas// bdag cag gyer dbyangs rol mos mdun bdar te// mgron du gnyer na rdzu 'phrul skad cig mi// shing rta la brten mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs// bzhugs gsol ni/

nang shes byed pos bskrun pa'i rkang stegs ni// stag gzig dar stan rim par bshams pa la// dge bsnyen 'khor bcas dgyes 'dzum zla gzhon gyi// snang ba dkar pos bsu bzhin brtan par bzhugs// mgron gsal gdab pa ni/ kye nyag brag zhes bya hor gyi yul grus bdag dge bsnyen 'bung chung stag ril zhes bya ba// sku yi bkrag mdangs ma zlum dkyil 'khor las// nges par 'phos snyam bzhin gsal mig gi dpyid// za 'og sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub dang*// gos bzang gser gyi ri mo bkra ba'i ber// rin thang gzhal med rin chen rgyan phreng dang*// dbu la 'od 'bar nor bu dar gyis brgyan// phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu'i yul phyogs kyi// rgud pa sel zhing dgos 'dod char du bsnyil// g.yon pas ro mchog brgya pa'i bza' btung gi /phyur bur gtams pa'i rin chen yol go bsnams// dpa' rtsal rmad byung zhang blon mthu bo che// dar dkar la thod gos bzang phod kha can// ri dwags mig gi sgeg pa'i btsun mo lcam// dar dang mu tig gser g.yu'i rgyan gyis brgyan// de dag mched 'khor sde dang dpung gi tshogs// rang phyogs bsrung zhing bstan pa'i bya ra la// mngon par rgyu tshe mgyogs pa'i rta la zhon// sra mkhregs go gyon 'khor gsum sked la bskor// dar mdung ral gri 'phyar zhing bstan srid la// rnam par sdang ba'i zhing bcu'i dgra 'tshol zhing*// srog gcod las la rngam pa'i 'khor tshogs bcas// gnam sa'i khyon yangs khyab par gsal bar gyur// bsang mchod stob pa ni/ kye dge bsnyen chen po sde 'khor dpung bcas la// dgyes par bskyed pa'i mthun rdzas 'bul ba ni// 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma'i ri bo bstar// ja chang bdud rtsi btung ba'i chu gter bskyil// dkar gsum mngar gsum phye mar gangs ri spungs// rta phyug bzhon ma'i rgyu skar nags su bkram// sna tshogs gos dar dbang po'i gzhu ris bkra// nas 'bras 'bru tshogs mi skya'i bang mdzod spun// dbyar skyes lha yi rkang 'thung bsregs pa'i sprin// nyes skyon sbyong la gaṅgā'i rgyun 'dra yang*// 'dod dgu 'byung la dpag bsam shing mtshungs pas// nam mkha'i khams kun dog por 'gengs pa 'dis// gnas bdag 'bung chung stag ril bsang ngo mchod// zhang blon btsun mo lcam sring bsang ngo mchod// mched 'khor sde dpung gter bdag bsang ngo mchod// mthu stobs rtsal ldan dpung tshogs bsang ngo mchod// bsung ldan padmas brgyan pa'i dag byed mtshor// ngang ngur grangs med dga' ba'i gar bsgyur zhing*// mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ltar mgron rigs rnams// dgyes pa'i ga zha dang bcas rol cig gu// gtor ma nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas te/

oṃ sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na massarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul lo// 'dod don bcol ba ni/ kye bdag cag yon sbyor 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// khyed cag bsrungs pa'i sa phyogs gang yin nas// sa brko rdo bslang shing gnyan bcad pa dang*// thab gzhob dme yugs grib kyis phog pa dang*// ro bag bskyas sogs bya spyod nyes pa yis// thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa gang byung ba// sprin tshogs mkha' la dengs pa ji bzhin du// bzod par bzhes nas rtag tu bsrung bar mdzod// chos sde dge 'dun dad pa'i sbyin bdag bcas// sdang zhing bsam sbyor ngan pa brtsam pa'i dgra// gang yin mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal bskyed nas// rigs dang rgud bcas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snang byed sa skya pa'i// lugs bzangs bstan pa'i bshad sgrub 'dzin skyong mkhan// bstan 'dzin mkhas btsun dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde// gur gum nags bzhin 'di na dar rgyas mdzod// sdom pa gsum gyi bslab gzhir gus byed cing*// gzhung lugs thos bsam bsgom pa las byung ba'i// lung rtogs yon tan rgyas pa'i phrin las kyis// chos dang sems can phan pa'i byed por shog /bsod nams ri bo rgyas pa'i ngos yangs nas// 'chi med tshe yi chu klung brgya phrag 'bab// chos srid phrin las nyi zla'i snang ba yi// 'jig rten phan bde'i 'dab stong phye bar mdzod// dkon mchog mchod dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur la// dad dga' dpal 'byor che ldan sbyin pa'i bdag /gang yin kun gyi rigs stobs 'byor pa rnams// dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// ljongs 'di'i mtshon pa'i rgyal khams 'gro ba spyi// 'thab rtsod bkres rngabs rgud pa mi 'byung zhing*// lo legs dpal 'byor dang ldan phan tshun dag /byams brtse dge ba'i sems kyis 'khod par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams nas lha mi klu'i// bde skyid dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phywa g.yang rnams// rgyal ba'i thugs rje bdag gi lhag bsam mthus// shis pa'i gnas 'dir g.yang du 'khyil bar mdzod// mgron gshegs su gsol ba ni/

bsang mchod gnas 'dir gang dag lhags pa rnams// mchod sbyin rgya chen stob pas mnyes gyur nas// swa sti'i sgra dbyangs snyan glu len bzhin pas// rang gnas bde bar bzhud pa'i tshul ston cig /ces nyag brag yul gyi gzhi bdag 'bung chung stag ril 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod 'dod 'byung sprin gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bla ma byams pa mkhyen rab pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi shis brjod nyan pos bsrungs pa'i bsti gnas su bris pa yi ge pa ni lhun grub phun tshogs kyis so// // ༄༅// smad shod phyogs kyi zo dor mu nam nga 'dra 'khor du bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang byang chub kyi// spyod pas legs par bskyangs pa kha ba'i ljongs// mdo khams gzhi bdag gtso bo zil phrom gyi// 'phrul blon mu nam nga 'dra ru 'dren sde// srid pa'i mi mthun rgud pa gzhil ba dang*// phun tshogs bde dga' spel la mthu che ba// 'khor bcas bsang mchod mgron du gnyer byed pa'i// bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbyangs snyan ldir// de'ang smad shod phyogs kyi zo dor 'khod dgu'i bsang mchod stob pas/ snod gcig tu zan leb zlum po'i steng dkar gtor gyi lto ba'i phyogs bzhir mtheb kyu bzhi dang mar rgyan btags pa/ de'i phyogs bzhir yang de 'dra ba bzhis bskor ba'i mthar g.yag lug ra sogs dang ri dwags bya rigs sogs kyis bskor ba'i mthar zan ril nyer lnga tsam gyi bskor/ gzhan yang phye mar mda' dar ja chang 'o phud sogs dang lha shing spos rigs sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang la/ bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel na mi dgos kyang*/ ma 'brel tshe sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba// 'bru gsum yi ger shar ba'i gzi brjid kyis// mchod rdzas bsang rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che// mchod yul mkha' lding rtsen pa'i gzhir gyur cig /oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ hrīḥrang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i sa bon las// 'gugs byed 'od kyi pho nya mang spros pas// dge chos dar bab mdo khams smad kyi char// dbang bsgyur rgyal po rdo rje g.yung drung gi /blon chen mu nam lha yi bsti gnas ri// sa 'dzin dbang po logs bzhi mi bdag dang*// nor bu rgyal mtshan shel gyi mchod rten dbyibs// dpangs mtho rgyu skar phreng ba rgyan du bsrel// lhun chags gyen 'phyur dbang po de yi nang*// lha gnas rnam rgyal khang pa dper byas pa'i// sna tshogs rin chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang*// dpal 'byor longs spyod 'bru rigs gter 'jo ba'i// gnas kyi bdag po nang blon gtso bo dang*// de yi 'khor yug kun du bkod legs kyi// ri bo'i phreng ba bkram pa'i sbubs yangs su// lha gnas rnams su bsti ba gzhi yi bdag /nga 'dra mched brgyad las mkhan ru 'dren bcu// rdo snying se ngur snying tshogs sde lnga sogs// thams cad rdzu 'phrul yid kyi shing rtar brten// bsang mchod gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// zhes pas spyan drangs/ gya nom bshams sprul mchod pa'i zhing 'di na// dgyes 'dzum dkar po'i 'khor yug mun pa yang*// nges par bkru snyam nyid du mchod sprin gyis// tshim par ma gyur de srid brtan par bzhugs// zhes pas bzhugs su gsol/ mgron gsal gdab pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul che ldan rnams kyi gzugs cha byad// gar mkhan lag pa'i zlos gar co 'dri'i phyir// mtha' gcig brjod nus bral yang thun mong du// yi ge rnying pa'i 'gros mtshungs 'di lta ste// brten par rten gyi ming chags mu nam zhes// srid pa'i lha chen ston zla ltar dkar ba'i// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum sgeg dpa' ba'i nyams// dbu la zhwa dkar g.yu ljang tog gis mdzes// sku la kā shi ka yi gos bzang la// padma rā ga'i thig les mdzes pa bgos// phyag g.yas mkha' lding rgyal mtshan cig shos na// dgos 'dod char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// rin thang gzhal med rin chen rgyan phreng dang*// dngul dkar pa tra 'khyil ba'i ska rags bcings// sag ti'i lh+wam gyi rab sgeg rol pa'i zhabs// 'jam zhing 'bol ba sna tshogs dar gdan gyis// legs par bkab pa'i rin chen khri steng brjid// lha chen rdzu 'phrul grub pa'i sprul pa ni// mi dkar dpa' bo stag shar cha lugs can// bsam pa'i gnas kun skad cig bskor bzod pa'i// rta dkar gser gyi sga srab mdzes pa bcibs// phyag g.yas rno ngar ral gri klad la bskor// g.yon pas stag gi rgyal mtshan phrag par brten// rol du gom stabs ldan pa'i rta mchog khrid// yul phyogs dgra sde srung ba'i bya rar rgyu// phyogs bzhir dgos pa gang phyir bgrod pa na// sna tshogs zhwa gos dpa' bo'i chas ldan la// mda' dang gnam ru'i shubs ma rked la bcings// stag dang 'phar ba dom gung chibs te rgyu// phyag na dar mdung la sogs mtshon cha 'phyar// yang sprul sha khrag rngam pa'i mche sder can// gcan gzan pho nya mang po dgra la 'gyed// gnam sa sgang rgyud chu bor 'grim pa'i tshe// khyung chen ger ling sha ba rus sbal sogs// yul kun thogs pa med pa'i bzhon pa bcas// lha btsan gnyan sogs 'byung po 'khor du khrid// mthu rtsal rmad byung nga 'dra mched brgyad ni// mi dkar gzi brjid nyi ma'i dpal la 'gran// bstan la gus ldan dge tshul brtul zhugs kyi// gos dmar gyis bklubs paṇa zhu dbu la gsol// dbang gi ba dan dmar po mkha' la 'phyar// mtshal bu gom stabs stong phrag bsgyur ba'i rta// rnga rngog dri bzhon gyis bskyod mig gi dpyid// dar stan sga srab mdzes pa'i steng na rol// mu nam lha yi bka' 'khor las byed pa// rab chab ces bya mi dmar khro 'dzum can// gang 'dod skad cig slebs pa'i btsan rta chibs// hor sog 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brjid pa dang*// gzhan yang gnyan chen rma tham dbal gyi bon// gangs ri 'gro shes lta bu'i g.yag dkar steng*// rin chen tog mdzes lhab lhub rgyal mtshan 'dzin// dpa' zhing rtul phod sngags pa'i cha lugs 'chang*// 'bam gnyan dbal gyi mi pho mda' gzhu dang*// bse yi ya lad bgos pa'i 'gying bag can// mgon brag gnyen chen mi dkar rta dkar zhon// zhub can ba dan rtse gsum phyag na bsnams// rog nu 'phrul gyi mi rje dar bab skur// srab 'jam dar gyi gos dang rin chen gyi// 'phyang 'phrul gyis brgyan bse yi mdung dmar bsgrengs// spu ris rnam bkra stag mo grus mar chibs// ra skyes dkar po zhon pa'i tshe rabs mi// dar dmar gos dang zangs khrab sku la gsol// bya dkar bon po gnyan po mthu bo che// stag zhu ras dkar gos gyon mdung rnon thogs// mdza' zla skyes bu dpa' bo dung khrab can// a shwa mog ro rgyan ldan steng na rol// ha khra dbal bon stag gi slog pa can// las mkhan mi rgod dri snom phag gi mchu// ne khra sprul pa'i mi dkar zla zhun gyi// gos bzang bklubs shing mgo bor la thod bcings// rdo snying phyug mo yid 'phrog mtsho sman dkar// rigs mthun sman btsun mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// se dur bon po phying sngon gos su gyon// dar ljang thod bcings rnga gshong phyag na bsnams// lha chen sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa yi// rtsa lag thod dkar snying tshogs sde lnga dang*// gzhan yang yul 'di'i sa chu rdo shing la// brten par bcas pa'i mgron rigs mthun pa'i rdzas// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs shing*// rgyas par spel ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i dpal// nyer spyod phreng dang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// zhi drag chas kyi rgyan gos sna tshogs dang*// dbang po kun tshang spu sdug 'gros mdzes kyi// g.yag lug ra skyes ri dwags rnam pa mang*// spu sdug skad kyi gling bu bsgyur mkhas pa'i// 'dab ldan mkha' la bskyod cing khyur rtse ba// rta phyugs bzhon ma nye bar mkho dgu dang*// shing thog sna tshogs lo legs 'bru yi tshogs// gser dngul g.yu dang byi ru shel gyi rigs// stong 'khun yul grur btags pa'i dar gos dang*// ja chang phye mar dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi// 'dod yon longs spyod mi zad rgya mtsho bskyil// bza' bca' spos rigs shing rtsi sna tshogs kyi// dud sprin gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor yongs khyab pa// nyams grib mi gtsang nyes tshogs kun sbyangs shing*// 'dod dgu'i yon tan dpal 'jo bsang mchod sprin// lha chen mu nam nga 'dra mched brgyad dang*// las mkhan ru 'dren bcu dang rdo snying phyug

/se dur bon sogs mgron rigs gang lhags pa// kun la 'bul lo dgyes shing tshim par rol// gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs la// oṃ sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba tha khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lya di swā hā/ lan gsum mam lngas phul/ phan par gdams shing 'dod don bcol ba ni/ kye de bzhin gshegs dang phyag na padma sogs// sems dpa' rnams kyis phan par gdams pa ltar// bslu med dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su zung*// gzhan don byang chub thob pa'i sems mchog bskyed// phyi nang chos kun me long gzugs brnyan bzhin// snang tsam skye 'gag bral ba'i tshul shes nas// bstan 'gror phan pa'i spyod pa legs spyad na// mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par som nyi ci// bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyis// khyed cag bsrungs pa'i sa phyogs gang rung nas// shing gnyan bcad dang sa brko rdo bslang dang*// thab gzhob dme yugs mi gtsang nyes pas phog /gson gshin bya ba nyes pa'i phog thug sogs// thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes tshogs bsang mchod 'di// phul bas tshon gyi dri mas bsgribs pa'i shel// dag byed chu yi bkrus ltar dwangs par mdzod// gzhir sdod byes bgrod gnas skabs thams cad du// mi dang nor phyugs bde skyid phrog byed pa'i// nad dang gdon bgegs 'byung po dgra 'dre yi// nyer 'tshe kun las bsrung dang zhi bar mdzod// mthun rkyen tshe yi sdong po ring du bskyed// bsod nams yal 'dab 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i khrod// chos srid 'byor pa'i me tog 'bras bu yi// khur gyis dud pa'i dpag bsam rgyas par mdzod// srid pa'i dpal 'byor rtsa ba rigs bzang rgyud// skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun ltar mi 'chad cing*// chos srid rnam par dpyod blo nyin mtshan gyi// snang ba'i sgron ma spun ltar gsal bar stsol// yid 'phrog dbang gi lcags kyu bskyod tsam gyi// skye 'gro'i snying gi brtan pa lhan cig nyid// chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sde tshogs kyi// 'byor dgu'i phywa g.yang rang dbang 'du bar mdzod// bsang gzhung dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe/

gshegs gsol ni/ bsang mchod mgron du gang dag lhags pa rnams// rab dga' rgyas pa'i swa sti'i dbyangs snyan ni// legs bris me na ka yi glu gar gyi// ngo mtshar rjes 'gro'i rang gnas dengs shig gu// dge ba bsngo ba ni/ mchod sbyin rgya chen stob pa'i dun du pa'i// lhag bsam bden stobs dbyug gu'i bskul ba'i mthus// phan bde'i sgra dbyangs srid pa'i khongs ldir bar// 'gro kun rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces smad shod phyogs kyi zo dor mu nam nga 'dra 'khor du bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ldan yul chos sde'i rdzong dpon bu dga'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ngag gi dbang po tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung me zla'i gnam gnon zhes bya'i bgrang gzhi'i khrums zla ba'i gza' tshes dge bar lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa ka lyā ṇa bha wantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
